title: Ship-Grade Stabilization — Build, Publish Surface, CLI Hygiene
source: Cycle 1 post-mortem + deep exploration of publishable surface
thesis: Cycle 1 fixed security and architecture. Cycle 2 makes it BUILDABLE and PUBLISHABLE. No new features — only fix what's broken and prune what's dead.
gate: Can a developer clone the repo, run npm install, npm run build, npm test — and have ALL THREE succeed with zero errors?
